findings.title: Model judge has no labeled calibration set
findings.description: A model judge with no labeled calibration set is an unvalidated measurement instrument: its scores have no demonstrated relationship to human judgment. Unanchored rubrics and unpinned sampling temperature make the verdicts drift further without anyone noticing.
evidence: grader uses model judge openai/gpt-4o-mini with no reference labels attached.
Judge scores are unvalidated against human judgment.
findings.remediation: Collect a labeled calibration set and report judge-vs-human agreement before trusting scores; anchor the rubric scale with explicit examples per level; pin temperature to 0 or take multiple repeats per item.

findings.title: Judge rubric has no explicit scale anchors
findings.description: A model judge with no labeled calibration set is an unvalidated measurement instrument: its scores have no demonstrated relationship to human judgment. Unanchored rubrics and unpinned sampling temperature make the verdicts drift further without anyone noticing.
evidence: judge rubric defines criteria but no anchored scale levels.
Without anchors, score meanings drift between runs and reviewers.
findings.remediation: Collect a labeled calibration set and report judge-vs-human agreement before trusting scores; anchor the rubric scale with explicit examples per level; pin temperature to 0 or take multiple repeats per item.

canonicalization.applies_to: the generated card HTML, before sha256
canonicalization.rule: Two mechanical substitutions: (1) replace <footer>...</footer> with <footer></footer>; (2) replace the methodology-table Generated row timestamp cell with the literal TIMESTAMP. The harness version string is kept: the pack pins the exact version, so a version mismatch must fail, not be normalized away.

First 12 complete JSONL records via ranged reads (2MB chunks). The hash covers exactly the 12 records consumed, as a JSON array of strings in canonical form (keys sorted, compact separators, UTF-8). Any blob drift changes this hash and fails verification loudly.
